paragraphs: Amatlai daughter of Karnevo (the mother of Abraham our father): Bava Batra 91a.[^1]

notes.text: The saved William Davidson Bava Batra91a paragraph names Amatlai daughter of Karnevo as Abraham’s mother. The English keeps Hyman’s parenthetical wording and our father honorific. The paragraph supports this local reading and folio locator; it does not establish an authority identity or independent historical genealogy. Other names and the mnemonic in that paragraph are not imported. This is named digital text evidence, not printed lettering or correction history.
